home.statement: I build systems that have to be right: real-time pipelines, distributed services and industrial IoT. Outside work I lead in Rotaract, as a club founder, past president and incoming district chair.
home.workIntro: Three of eight systems, each described by the problem it solved before the tools it used.

work.title: Problems first, stack second.
work.sub: Anyone can list technologies. These are the problems they were pointed at: eight systems, each with a short case study.

experience.title: The record, and the tools.
experience.sub: Where I've worked, what I did there and what I can do. Each claim points at something I built or designed.

leadership.title: I've run the kind of institution I build for.
leadership.sub: A club is a small institution. Running one teaches you what software can and cannot fix, and most of my engineering judgement came from it.

about.title: Engineer. Also, organiser.
about.sub: I build the systems that have to be right, not just running. And I've sat in the meetings where the numbers they produce get defended.

contact.title: Tell me what you're building.
contact.sub: Open to remote engineering roles, architecture engagements and speaking invitations. I reply within two working days.

footer.line: If it has to be right, let's talk.
